title: Second-round runtime responsiveness improvements
scope: Active editor metering, playback preparation and automation scheduling. Initial loading excluded.

findings.change: Retain logarithmic bucket boundaries per analyser until its bounded FFT geometry changes.
findings.evidence: A warm tick computes zero bucket powers/floors/ceilings instead of 256 powers and 128 floor/ceil pairs. Changed geometry rebuilds once.
findings.limitations: The 128 published bucket values remain independent and still read current analyser data.

findings.change: Accumulate stereo correlation during the existing scope-extrema traversal, avoiding a second complete stereo PCM scan.
findings.evidence: Exact correlation and scope points agree with independent former algorithms for seven input geometries, including partial buckets.
findings.limitations: Parity and eliminated scan established; no isolated Electron latency attribution.

findings.change: Calculate aggregate peak and RMS in one channel traversal without a mapped peak array or argument spread.
findings.evidence: Regression rejects any mapped channel array and verifies exact original scalar arithmetic.
findings.limitations: At most 32 declared channels; allocation/work reduction rather than a whole-workflow timing claim.

findings.change: Reuse privately normalized frozen lanes instead of detaching and recompiling their interpolation curves again. Recheck descriptor ranges and persisted/capture point caps.
findings.evidence: Known normalized lanes retain identity; arbitrary changed external input still detaches; a restrictive descriptor and oversized capture still reject.
findings.limitations: Only objects admitted by this module’s private WeakMap qualify. Descriptor validation remains mandatory.

findings.change: Binary-search the first relevant tempo boundary and visit only boundaries inside each automation segment instead of filtering the whole tempo map per segment.
findings.evidence: Ten linear segments over 200 tempos remove 2000 full-filter element examinations; all eleven exact scheduled events remain identical.
findings.limitations: Tempo boundaries still prepare once and relevant interior boundaries remain included.

findings.change: Reuse the frozen strip snapshot array between updates rather than copying the store on every query.
findings.evidence: Repeated queries retain identity; successful update/reset invalidate; failed admission retains prior publication; eviction preserves detached earlier results.
findings.limitations: Only internally owned immutable snapshots are reused.

findings.change: Retain a frozen loudness-history publication while the engine's loudness reading is unchanged.
findings.evidence: Ten unchanged meter ticks share one publication instead of ten history copies; changed reading appends once and reset clears it.
findings.limitations: Uses the same reading-identity admission as before; changed readings still publish the bounded history.

findings.change: Prepare detached exact tempo frame/beat/rate facts once per schedule and binary-search active segments for adaptive curve evaluations.
findings.evidence: 100 prepared queries on 1000 tempos read zero authored events; musical/sample-locked/rounded-coincident boundaries retain exact parity. Curved scheduling keeps preparation reads bounded regardless of recursive evaluations.
findings.limitations: Preparation remains linear; no global identity cache admits arbitrary mutable tempo inputs. Public one-shot inverse remains unchanged.

findings.change: Evaluate the first adaptive curve probe once rather than once during initialization and again in the probe loop.
findings.evidence: Each subdivision removes one interpolation query; existing scheduler and exact curved event-value tests pass.
findings.limitations: Code-confirmed removed duplicate evaluation; combined scheduling timing does not isolate this contribution.

findings.change: Build track/bus latency maps directly, avoiding filter/map projections and spread-based maximum materialization.
findings.evidence: Preparation rejects intermediate track filtering in the regression; 150000-track plan no longer overflows an argument list. Filtered fallback indexes and standard-effect latency parity pass.
findings.limitations: Effects still require authoritative per-owner latency evaluation; maps remain invocation-local.

discardedCandidates.change: Fuse strip finite validation and scalar statistics; reuse channel energies for correlation.
discardedCandidates.reason: Fewer sample reads did not yield a reliable improvement: representative warmed 256-frame tests measured a slowdown, so production kernels retain their original loops.
